house.1: It lights up how you feel and how you come across for you.
house.2: It lights up money, food and family for you.
house.3: It lights up messages, siblings and short trips for you.
house.4: It lights up home, comfort and your mother for you.
house.5: It lights up creativity, romance and children for you.
house.6: It lights up health, daily work and routines for you.
house.7: It lights up partners and close relationships for you.
house.8: It lights up shared money and deep changes for you.
house.9: It lights up luck, learning and long journeys for you.
house.10: It lights up career and reputation for you.
house.11: It lights up friends, networks and gains for you.
house.12: It lights up rest, spending and letting go for you.

Sun.easy: A good month to step up and be noticed.
Sun.steady: Give it attention, but don’t force things.

Mars.easy: Extra energy here. Use it to get things moving.
Mars.steady: Energy runs high here, so go steady and pick your battles.

Jupiter.easy: A slow, generous opening. Say yes to good offers.
Jupiter.steady: Growth comes quietly here. Patience pays.

Saturn.easy: Steady effort here pays off well.
Saturn.steady: Things may feel slower here. Small, steady steps work best.
